Or will I drop into old Harrises and have a chat with young Sinclair?
Well-minnered fellow, probably at his lunch.
Must get those old glasses of mine set right.
Goers lenses six guineas, Germans making their way everywhere.
Sell on easy terms to capture trade.
Might chance on a pair in the railway-lost property office, astonishing the things people
